pr_title: [3.x] Fix for 2D viewport not updating in the editor when the camera moves
pr_body:
This fixes a problem with 2D viewports not taking the camera position into consideration when previewed in the editor.

Backport of #69644.

Fixes #40441

<!--
Please target the `master` branch in priority.
PRs can target `3.x` if the same change was done in `master`, or is not relevant there.

Relevant fixes are cherry-picked for stable branches as needed by maintainers.
You can mention in the description if the change is compatible with `3.x`.
-->
pr_comments: Aside for the braces comment above, this looks fine, will wait for the fix before approving.
I seem to have fixed it locally and then forgotten to push the changes. Anyways, they're up!

> Note that if get_tree() or get_edited_scene_root() fail, this will crash

`get_tree()` is handled by `!is_inside_tree()` condition above.
`get_edited_scene_root()` by `Engine::get_singleton()->is_editor_hint()` (AFAIK scene root is null only on empty scenes).

issue_context.title: Viewports do not register 2D Cameras while in the editor
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
v3.2.1


**OS:**
Windows 10


**Issue description:**
When rendering the contents of a Viewport while in the editor, it ignores Camera2Ds. The bug does not occur when rendering 3D objects using a viewport.


**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Open reproduction project 
4. Observe editor preview of a Viewport with a 2D scene with 2D.tscn

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34634373/87640338-8e5db280-c714-11ea-8f3b-4d2d0811cc7b.png)

5. Run 2D.tscn (the view now correctly uses the Camera2D)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34634373/87640385-a3d2dc80-c714-11ea-9f9b-45facbe8877e.png)

**Minimal reproduction project:**
[ViewportTextureEditorBug.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/4929957/ViewportTextureEditorBug.zip)
comments: Wow, that was fast, how did you find a duplicate so quickly? I spent almost an hour scanning through the issue tracker.

@Calinou Actually I don't believe this issue is a duplicate of #39387, that one is about the viewport's child nodes not displaying when selected but this issue is about 2D cameras not registering with the viewport until runtime.

@Nikhil-42 Maybe this one then? https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/19638

It's about 3D, but the underlying issue is the same.
@Calinou #19638 is more similar but my issue is persistent even after restarting the editor and duplicating the viewport container. Also, I am unable to duplicate my issue with a 3D camera.
@Calinou do you know where in the source 2d cameras are registered to a viewport? I checked viewport.cpp and viewport.h but the only mention of a Camera2D was an unused forward class declaration.
@Calinou No worries, I'll just look a little deeper.
Also, I get errors while compiling the master branch. When opening a pull request should I still merge into master even though I cannot test it?
Same issue persists in v4.1.1.stable.official [bd6af8e0e], however the editor displays the camera's view correctly when the Camera2D's `enabled` property is unchecked and checked again.

review_comments: Needs braces around the `return;` as in your 4.x PR, that's the coding convention even for one liners.
